extracted.intended_audience: researchers and practitioners in AI, recommender systems, and real-estate technology; policymakers and ethicists interested in fair and explainable decision-support for property search
extracted.subtask_description: A PRISMA-compliant systematic review of research on real-estate recommender systems (RERS), assessing algorithmic approaches, data modalities, evaluation practices, and ethical considerations and proposing a Trust-based Evaluation (T-EVAL) framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-compliant systematic review (the review is described as PRISMA-compliant).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PRISMA reporting standards for systematic reviews (transparent search strategy, inclusion/exclusion criteria, study selection flow, data extraction, and synthesis). The page does not list the PRISMA checklist items but indicates adherence to that standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimodality / multimodal fusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus on multimodal data modalities and fusion methods in RERS (title and tags highlight 'Multimodal' and 'multimodal fusion').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether systems integrate heterogeneous inputs (text, images, geospatial data, temporal features, etc.) and how fusion is performed; assess effectiveness of multimodal representations for recommendation quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spatio-temporal modeling
rubrics_metrics.description: Spatio-temporal innovations in RERS (the review examines 'spatio-temporal' aspects).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether models account for spatial and temporal dynamics of listings/markets (e.g., location-aware features, temporal trends) and how those dynamics affect recommendations and evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explainability / adoption of Explainable AI (XAI)
rubrics_metrics.description: Explainable AI: the review notes a lag in adoption of state-of-the-art post-hoc XAI frameworks (no reviewed work implements state-of-the-art post-hoc XAI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether systems provide interpretable explanations, use modern XAI methods, and how explanations are validated with users; lack of post-hoc XAI is flagged as a shortcoming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transfer learning (TL) adoption
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of transfer learning: the review finds no reviewed work implements state-of-the-art TL frameworks despite relevance for data scarcity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether models use transfer learning or other data-efficient techniques to handle limited labeled data and cross-domain generalization; consider pretraining, fine-tuning, and domain adaptation approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness-aware methods and fairness auditing
rubrics_metrics.description: Fairness-aware innovations: the review finds limited fairness auditing despite documented discrimination risks in housing markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include fairness audits and bias assessments (e.g., demographic disparate impact, fairness metrics), evaluate whether models mitigate discrimination risks, and report fairness evaluation procedures and results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Predictive accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Predictive accuracy is a core component of the proposed Trust-based Evaluation (T-EVAL) framework (T-EVAL integrates predictive accuracy, user trust, fairness, and market efficiency).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure standard recommendation accuracy metrics (e.g., RMSE, NDCG, precision/recall) while situating accuracy relative to other trust and fairness objectives; report evaluation protocols and baselines.

rubrics_metrics.name: User trust
rubrics_metrics.description: User trust is explicitly named as a component of the T-EVAL framework.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess perceived trust and usability of explanations and recommendations (user studies, trust metrics, qualitative feedback); consider how explanations and transparency affect user trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market efficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: Market efficiency is included as a T-EVAL dimension alongside accuracy, trust, and fairness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate broader market-level impacts of recommender interventions (e.g., liquidity, price discovery, matching efficiency) and include measures that capture economic or market outcomes where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data efficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: Data-efficient RERS are emphasized in the paper's call for next-generation systems (the review proposes data-efficient designs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate algorithms for sample efficiency, use of pretraining/transfer, semi-supervised techniques, and strategies that reduce dependence on large proprietary labeled datasets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dataset openness / proprietary dataset reliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Reliance on proprietary datasets: the review reports 80% reliance on proprietary datasets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer open/public datasets to improve reproducibility and comparability; report dataset provenance, licensing, and accessibility; flag heavy reliance on proprietary data as a limitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic representativeness
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic concentration: the review finds geographic concentration in Asia (56%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess geographic diversity of study datasets and whether findings generalize across regions; report geographic coverage and potential geographic biases in datasets and models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Property-type representativeness
rubrics_metrics.description: Property-type focus: dominance of residential property studies (91%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether research covers multiple property types (residential, commercial, industrial) and note overconcentration on residential market as a limitation for broader applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption of modern AI techniques (e.g., deep learning)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adoption of deep learning: the review reports deep learning is employed in 15% of studies, indicating slow uptake of state-of-the-art AI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether contemporary modeling techniques (deep learning, advanced representation learning) are used appropriately and whether methodological advances are adopted to improve performance or interpretability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency and ethical considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Ethical considerations and transparency are emphasized in calls for 'transparent, ethical, and data-efficient next-generation RERS.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate ethical risk assessment, transparency of model design and data use, disclosure of limitations, and inclusion of governance or remediation plans for harms (e.g., discrimination).
